SELECT f.id, f.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(g.link_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND (g.link_url NOT LIKE 'wa://group/%' OR NULLIF(TRIM(), '') IS NOT NULL) AND = 1 AND COALESCE(, 0) = 0 THEN 1 END) AS groupCount, f.created_at AS createdAt, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM group_folder f LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND g.folder_id = f.id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND current_group.id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite current_invite ON current_invite.tenant_id = current_profile.tenant_id AND current_invite.id = current_profile.current_invite_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite input_invite ON input_invite.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND input_invite.id = g.group_invite_id WHERE GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.created_at, f.updated_at ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
